O.scope: P11 four-category B2/tg8 target.step host boundary

amdahl_declaration.zero_cost_ceiling: not assigned until an executable Qwen4Exp block-verifier candidate exists
amdahl_declaration.arithmetic_class: candidate not implemented; future verifier must declare T0 exact or a qualified production class
overlap_exclusions: proposal wall is disjoint from target verification

blocking_deltas: _prefill_chunk mutates and commits every GDN, QSA, PLE, KV, index, and host PLE-hash row; it has no deferred accepted-prefix commit
_prefill_chunk returns one last-row residual pointer and optional hidden rows but does not score or return every target row
Qwen4Exp head scratch and logits buffers have rows=1 capacity
Qwen4ExpRunnerSnapshot copies recurrent state device-to-host and restores host-to-device, so it cannot provide a device-resident transaction
Qwen3.5 verifier code depends on a different linear-state, layer, and graph ABI and cannot be registered against Qwen4Exp unchanged
required_subunits: add rows<=8 target residual/head/logit buffers and per-row output ownership
add device-resident GDN/PLE state snapshots plus QSA KV/index cursor transaction ownership
add deferred accepted-prefix state commit or exact state-row capture
add serial-reference RED coverage for rows 2 through 8 before provider wiring
only then profile and build a Qwen4Exp verifier graph

decision.next_independent_owner: P11 device-output cleanup can proceed independently while the verifier ABI is built in separate RED-gated subunits
decision.reason: No executable Qwen4Exp block-verifier candidate exists, so a speedup or same-session A/B cannot be measured honestly.
